title: The 24 Solar Terms
prompt: Explain the origin and significance of the 24 solar terms in ancient China.
hint: Describe how ancient Chinese scholars observed natural phenomena and divided the sun's annual movements.
sample: Ancient Chinese scholars observed the climate, seasons, and astronomy, dividing the sun's annual path into 24 solar terms to guide agriculture.

title: Summer Solstice Traditions
prompt: Describe the customs and lifestyle of farmers during the summer solstice in ancient China.

sample: During the summer solstice, farmers weed their fields and eat pickles and noodles for health and longevity.
